architecture_confirmed_by_pdf.split: Global timestamp ascending, training/validation/test 80/10/10; not user splitting or per-user leave-last-out
architecture_confirmed_by_pdf.baseline: Paper Appendix A TIGER: scratch decoder-only, standard per-level NTP; no SPROUT components
architecture_confirmed_by_pdf.metric: Item-exact Recall@100, deduplicated, historical items retained

optimizer: AdamW betas=(.9,.98), no weight decay on normalization or tied embeddings
schedule: 1000 update linear warmup, cosine to 0.1x LR; same effective batch32
batching: seeded local length grouping, window2048, each event once per epoch
training_hyperparameters: Repaired independent recipe, not author-provided; all A-E share it
selection: validation mean NTP loss; no test selection
embedding_loss: TRAIN-only unordered i2i upstream; GR is chronological NTP, no SPROUT losses
